title: Cloud City: Case Study: Mountkirk Games — Global Multiplayer & Spanner

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: The City Colosseum was hosting games, but spectators from across the globe had to send carrier pigeons to place bets, resulting in delayed wagers and lost tickets.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Arena Master Marcus built telegraph scoreboards (Global Load Balancer) and connected regional betting kiosks directly to the Central Vault (Cloud Spanner).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When 100,000 extra spectators arrived, Marcus opened additional arena turnstiles (GKE Autopilot) within minutes.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical colosseums have fixed stone seating; cloud gaming backends auto-scale elastically to absorb millions of concurrent players.
